desc: Ideation: derive identity f(s) = s − Σ_{k≥1}[2^k|s]·(s/2^k), ordered-pair reduction, and hand-verify on sample 1
Implement full program (I/O, k=1..24 correction loop with sort+searchsorted residue counting, diagonal term via `A // (A & -A)`, final `(total+D)//2`)
Verify correctness by hand-tracing sample 1 ([4,8] → 5) and edge cases N=1, all-equal values; confirm int64 bounds (≤4·10¹⁷) and no huge-array allocation
Sanity-check performance for N=2·10⁵ with 24 sorts (24 × sort+2 searchsorted on 2·10⁵ int64 ≈ well under limit; no 2^k arrays allocated)
